# A program's own C natives, leak checked on the interpreter: every call is
# stubbed, so nothing here is compiled or linked. Under --simulate the string a
# native is handed is the C string the Go backend allocates for it, which
# nothing frees (#110); without it there is no C at all.

env PATH=

! sngl test --simulate gtk4 app.sngl
stdout '^--- PASS: /testFreed '
stdout '^--- PASS: /testMoved '
stdout '^--- PASS: shows/testRetainedUntilUnmount '
stdout '^--- PASS: toggles/testRetainedUntilBranchLeaves '
stdout '^    leak: the C.CString allocated at app.sngl:36:5 was never released$'
stdout '^    leak: the buf allocated at app.sngl:45:13 was never released$'
stdout '^    buf passed after it was moved: allocated at app.sngl:50:13, moved at app.sngl:51:5, passed at app.sngl:52:14$'
stdout '^    buf released while a native retains it: allocated at app.sngl:85:13, retained at app.sngl:88:9, released at app.sngl:89:9$'
stdout '^not ok   8 tests, 4 failures$'

! sngl test app.sngl
stdout '^--- PASS: /testWrites '
! stdout 'C.CString'
stdout '^not ok   8 tests, 3 failures$'

-- app.sngl --
import macro "sngl:macro"
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:test"
import c "sngl:x/c"

#[macro.cnative("buf_t *")]
#[macro.owned(bufFree)]
struct buf {}

#[macro.cnative("buf_new")]
func bufNew(size int) buf

#[macro.cnative("buf_free")]
func bufFree(b buf)

#[macro.cnative("buf_len")]
func bufLen(b buf) int

#[macro.cnative("buf_write")]
func bufWrite(b buf, text string)

#[macro.cnative("sink_take")]
func sinkTake(#[macro.moves] b buf)

#[macro.cnative("view_show")]
func viewShow(#[macro.retains] b buf)

func testFreed(t test.Test) {
    var b = bufNew(4)
    t.assert(bufLen(b) == 0)
    bufFree(b)
}

func testWrites(t test.Test) {
    var b = bufNew(7)
    bufWrite(b, "hello")
    bufFree(b)
}

func testMoved(t test.Test) {
    sinkTake(bufNew(1))
}

func testLeaks(t test.Test) {
    var b = bufNew(2)
    t.assert(bufLen(b) == 0)
}

func testUseAfterMove(t test.Test) {
    var b = bufNew(3)
    sinkTake(b)
    t.assert(bufLen(b) == 0)
}

component shows ui.node {
    var b = bufNew(5)

    effect(
        @mount {
            viewShow(b)
        },
        @unmount {
            bufFree(b)
        },
    )
}

func testRetainedUntilUnmount(t test.Test, c shows) {
}

component toggles ui.node {
    var on = true

    if on {
        shows
    }
}

func testRetainedUntilBranchLeaves(t test.Test, c toggles) {
    c.on = false
    t.assert(!c.on)
}

component freesEarly ui.node {
    var b = bufNew(6)

    effect(@mount {
        viewShow(b)
        bufFree(b)
    })
}

func testReleasedWhileRetained(t test.Test, c freesEarly) {
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    shows
}

c.link(include="buf.h")
